purpose: Prevent terminal transcripts from becoming executable payloads, keep field windows operator-controlled, make durable evidence discoverable without repeated physical mutations, and keep operator continuations on the current canonical implementation.

rules.meaning: PowerShell prompt prefixes are transcript metadata, never executable payload.
PowerShell continuation prompts are transcript metadata, never executable payload.
When a tracked launcher covers the field workflow, operators receive the launcher and concrete field values instead of reconstructed multi-line shell sessions.
Any copyable inline command is one complete physical line containing executable text only. Multi-step work belongs in a tracked script or launcher.

Operator copy/paste commands must not terminate the caller's PowerShell or Windows Terminal session with exit. Launchers may return an exit code after preserving evidence and explicitly yielding window closure to the operator.
Every field capsule must publish stable latest result and summary paths so terminal closure does not destroy the operator's ability to recover or share evidence.
A successful physical proof is durable evidence. Normal follow-up diagnostics must not print another test page merely to re-prove already observed functionality.

When an implementation bug misclassified already-captured evidence, repair the derived classification from the preserved artifact without repeating target contact, network activity, or physical mutation.

Once a registered capsule is merged or superseded, operator next-actions resolve from its canonical mainline ref. Historical PR branches and pinned historical SHAs are review evidence, not field retry sources.

If a historical branch no longer equals an expected pinned SHA, stop that command and reconcile the current default-branch implementation. Do not ask the operator to chase the old SHA or recreate a historical worktree.
Evidence repair is eligible only when a preserved artifact explicitly needs reclassification. A reported successful real document print does not itself require the repair launcher.

A follow-up printer check for a remote mapped PC must preserve that target identity from explicit input or the latest complete canonical mapping evidence. Absence of the queue on the technician/controller workstation is not evidence that the remote target lost SYSTEM + HKLM machine-wide registration. If current target context is unavailable or ambiguous, fail closed instead of substituting the controller workstation or historical proof.
